title: My dad's watch stopped the moment he died - I found it in the ashes of Hong Kong tower fire
description: The city marks a year since a huge blaze tore through seven apartment blocks, killing 168 people.
text: Mr So's parents, both in their 80s, were among the 168 people killed in last year's Hong Kong tower-block blaze - the deadliest the city had seen in decades.
Their building was the first of the Wang Fuk Court complex to catch fire, and their bodies were burned beyond recognition.
In this video Mr So, who is only using his surname, visits his parents' grave and shows what is left of his parents' possessions.
Video by Phoebe Kong and Yik Lam, BBC Chinese
